CCfits Compound List

Here are the classes, structs, unions and interfaces with brief descriptions:
  • CCfits::AsciiTable (Class Representing Ascii Table Extensions)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::auto_array_ptr (A class that mimics the std:: library auto_ptr class, but works with arrays)
  • CCfits::BinTable (Class Representing Binary Table Extensions. Contains columns with scalar or vector row entries)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::CAarray (Function object returning C array from a valarray. see CVarray for details)
  • CCfits::FITS::CantCreate (Thrown on failure to create new file)
  • CCfits::FITS::CantOpen (Thrown on failure to open existing file)
  • CCfits::Column (Abstract base class for Column objects)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::CVAarray (Function object returning C array from a vector of valarrays. see CVarray for details)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::CVarray (Function object class for returning C arrays from standard library objects used in the FITS library implementation)
  • CCfits::ExtHDU (Base class for all FITS extension HDUs, i.e. Image Extensions and Tables)
  • CCfits::FITS (Memory object representation of a disk FITS file)
  • CCfits::FitsError (FitsError is the exception thrown by non-zero cfitsio status codes)
  • CCfits::FitsException (FitsException is the base class for all exceptions thrown by this library)
  • CCfits::FitsFatal ([potential] base class for exceptions to be thrown on internal library error)
  • CCfits::HDU (Base class for all HDU [Header-Data Unit] objects)
  • CCfits::Column::InsufficientElements (Exception thrown if the data supplied for a write operation is less than declared)
  • CCfits::Column::InvalidDataType (Exception thrown for invalid data type inputs)
  • CCfits::HDU::InvalidExtensionType (Exception to be thrown if user requests extension type that can not be understood as ImageExt, AsciiTable or BinTable)
  • CCfits::HDU::InvalidImageDataType (Exception to be thrown if user requests creation of an image of type not supported by cfitsio)
  • CCfits::Column::InvalidNumberOfRows (Exception thrown if user enters a non-positive number for the number of rows to write)
  • CCfits::Column::InvalidRowNumber (Exception thrown on attempting to read a row number beyond the end of a table)
  • CCfits::Column::InvalidRowParameter (Exception thrown on incorrect row writing request)
  • CCfits::Keyword (Abstract base class implementing the common behavior of Keyword objects)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::MatchName (Predicate for classes that have a name attribute; match input string with instance name)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::MatchNum (Predicate for classes that have an index attribute; match input index with instance value)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::MatchPtrName (As for MatchName, only with the input class a pointer)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::MatchPtrNum (As for MatchNum, only with the input class a pointer)
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::MatchType (Function object that returns the FITS ValueType corresponding to an input intrinsic type)
  • CCfits::HDU::NoNullValue (Exception to be thrown on seek errors for keywords)
  • CCfits::Column::NoNullValue (Exception thrown if a null value is specified without support from existing column header)
  • CCfits::Table::NoSuchColumn (Exception to be thrown on a failure to retrieve a column specified either by name or index number)
  • CCfits::FITS::NoSuchHDU (Exception thrown by HDU retrieval methods)
  • CCfits::HDU::NoSuchKeyword (Exception to be thrown on seek errors for keywords)
  • CCfits::FITS::OperationNotSupported (Thrown for unsupported operations, such as attempted to select rows from an image extension)
  • CCfits::PHDU (Class representing the primary HDU for a FITS file)
  • CCfits::Column::RangeError (Exception to be thrown for inputs that cause range errors in column read operations)
  • CCfits::Table
  • CCfits::FITSUtil::MatchType::UnrecognizedType (Exception thrown by MatchType if it encounters data type incompatible with cfitsio)
  • CCfits::Column::WrongColumnType (Exception thrown on attempting to access a scalar column as vector data)
  • CCfits::ExtHDU::WrongExtensionType (Exception to be thrown on unmatched extension types)
